# NASHA blueprint status: horizons, completeness map, investor diagnostic (generated by tools/blueprint_views.py; do not hand-edit)

**Truth boundary.** Investor-ready means a sophisticated reader can understand the concept, product, differentiation, development status, market hypothesis, operating model, economic model, capital path, risks, unresolved questions and use of funds WITHOUT being misled. It does not mean ready to open. Lane B (digital planning). Evidence stays 4/95 and design 43/95: digital work never raises physical evidence.

## Three development horizons (founder direction D-81)

| Horizon | What | Status |
|---|---|---|
| **A - $0 FOUNDER BUILD** | research, design, modeling, coding, website, brand system, menu development, personal cooking, photography, financial and operations modeling, digital twin, investor materials, data room | DO NOW |
| **B - LOW-COST VALIDATION** | ingredients, repeated home prototypes, supplier samples, small lawful tastings, basic photography materials | WHEN SMALL AMOUNTS OF MONEY EXIST |
| **C - FUNDED PROFESSIONAL EXECUTION** | attorneys, formation, permits, qualified brewer, commercial pilots, architect, MEP, kitchen, insurance, lease, equipment, construction, staff, launch | AFTER CAPITAL EXISTS |

Not allowed without a new founder decision: forming the business, filing trademarks, signing leases, buying commercial equipment, applying for permits, selling food or alcohol, taking payments, booking events, hiring, advertising, announcing an opening, opening reservations or ordering, publishing an opening date.

**digital scale:** 0 = nothing; 1 = outlined; 2 = drafted in docs or data; 3 = data-backed STRUCTURE validated by tools, generated view where applicable (inputs may all still be unknown); 4 = everything possible at zero cost is done and independently reviewed
**real_world scale:** 0 = no real-world observation; 1 = desk or public-source observation only; 2 = one personal prototype or measurement with preserved originals; 3 = repeated personal prototypes with documented iteration; 4 = external real-world evidence (guests, vendors, sales)
**professional scale:** 0 = no professional input (agent analysis is NOT professional review); 1 = one professional informal input recorded; 2 = a qualified professional review of part; 3 = a qualified professional review complete

Agent analysis is never counted as professional review. Real-world level 1 means desk or public-source observation only.

## Pre-capital blueprint completion

**Lead with this: 0 of 5 criteria that need the founder's real cooking, photographs and receipts are done.** Overall count for context only: 53% (7 done, 5 partial, 6 not done of 18 criteria; DONE = 1, PARTIAL = 0.5). Method: criteria are listed below; the percentage counts criteria, it does not weight quality or importance, and it is NOT a readiness score and NOT declared complete. Split: digital and desk criteria 9.5 of 13 (73%); criteria that need the founder's physical work (cooking, photographs, receipts) 0 of 5 (0%). The headline number therefore overstates progress on real evidence: physical completion is the number that matters most.

| Operating, kitchen, brewery and guest blueprints | bp-*.csv | **DONE** | YES | proposed, not field validated |
| Market map and competitor analysis | AUSTIN-MARKET-MAP.md | **PARTIAL** | YES | public sources only |

PRE-CAPITAL BLUEPRINT COMPLETE will mean: every criterion above is DONE, every area is at digital level 3 or higher or marked as needing a professional, and an independent investor red-team finds no unsupported claim. It is not declared now.
